rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card, impostor table and dated predictions before data; synthetic validation on all 24 real transition skeletons, which exposed a normalization bias and led to a pre-data amendment (ratio switching time); replication on 24 transitions in two regimes and both embedding models; natives G39 and NE38; estimates rows; confirm.py frozen with a passing dry run (not run). Missing: holdout run, a two-stage fit, power for the order test.
rationale.faithfulness: The quench reading is strong and model-robust: day-1 remanence 0.18-0.27 of the pre level vs 0.85-0.89 across ordinary nights (RE CI below 0 in both models), and a single-agent reassignment quenches beyond all 22 placebos. HH123's coercivity is not supported; its test has power 0.50 and the trend is reversed. Scorecard A1 B1 C2 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: A clear operator fact: no need to clear a swarm before reassigning it; the new kickoff erases the old content state within the first active hour, with a small residual over ~1 active day. Also a methods warning: cosine decay times on unit vectors depend on the amplitude, which biases order-vs-timescale comparisons in other cards.

one_line: A goal switch quenches the old content state within the first active hour (day-1 remanence 0.18-0.27 vs 0.85-0.89 across a night); no order-dependent coercivity (test power 0.50, sign reversed).
